providers.name: Groq
providers.free: Free tier, no card. Fast open models (gpt-oss-120b, Llama, Qwen); a daily token ceiling per model.

providers.name: Google Gemini (AI Studio)
providers.free: Free tier, no card. Gemini Flash models with per-minute and per-day limits.

providers.name: Speka
providers.free: $1 of usage included every month, no card. One OpenAI-compatible key for gpt-oss-20b, GLM, Nemotron, Llama and more.
providers.note: Keyed in our chain, but it has not answered our calls since 30 October.

providers.name: Z.ai
providers.free: glm-4.5-flash is list-priced at $0; no card. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

providers.name: Ollama Cloud
providers.free: Free plan, no card. Hosted open models (gpt-oss:120b and others) behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

providers.name: Gonka Broker
providers.free: Free tier, no card: about 6 requests a minute and roughly a million tokens a month, for GLM, DeepSeek and MiniMax Flash models behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
providers.note: Its own pages call it “free or trial”, so the allowance may not last. In our chain since 6 November 2026.

providers.name: Mistral (La Plateforme)
providers.free: Free plan, no card, but you must activate it in the console: a fresh key has zero request quota until you do.
providers.note: Keyed in our chain, but it has never answered our calls.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free: Models tagged :free cost nothing; about 50 requests a day without credit on the account.
providers.note: Keyed in our chain, but it has never answered our calls; the free pool is shared, and a test call on 24 September came back rate-limited upstream (429).

providers.name: Free.ai
providers.free: 30,000 tokens a day of its self-hosted Qwen model, no card, behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
providers.note: Small: about five of our calls a day. It left our chain on 30 October when the allowance was used up.

providers.name: Dahl Inference
providers.free: Free access to GLM, MiniMax and DeepSeek Flash models, no card.
providers.note: Keyed, but out of our chain: its free allowance was exhausted.

providers.name: SambaNova Cloud
providers.free: Free tier, no card, for Llama and DeepSeek models.
providers.note: Verified on its pages; not in our chain yet.

providers.name: OrcaRouter
providers.free: Free models through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, no card. The free lineup rotates as new models arrive.
providers.note: Caveat: our key is valid, but on 2 October the free models still refused it until the account counts as established (it asks for a linked GitHub account). Not in our chain yet.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.free: A free daily allowance of neurons, no card; needs a (free) Cloudflare account and API token.
providers.note: Recorded by our Scout; not in use.

providers.name: QuickEmailVerification
providers.free: 100 verifications a day, no card; the daily credits never expire. Flags disposable, role and catch-all addresses.
providers.note: Our lead finder checks every email with it before a lead is recorded.

providers.name: Sniffmail
providers.free: 500 basic checks a month, no card: syntax, MX and disposable detection. Deep SMTP checks are paid.
providers.note: Our backup when the daily QuickEmailVerification credits run out.

providers.name: Tavily
providers.free: 1,000 API credits a month, no card, for search, extract and crawl.
providers.note: Kept for special searches: only our CEO agent calls it, by choice, never as an automatic fallback.

providers.name: Together AI
providers.note: trial credit, then paid.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.free: 1M tokens a day, 5 requests a minute -- only after adding a card
providers.note: advertises a free tier, but our account was asked for a payment method.

providers.name: DeepSeek, OpenAI, Moonshot, Replicate
providers.note: pay-as-you-go from the first call.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.free: trial key, 1,000 calls a month, 20 requests a minute on Chat -- but the signup wanted a card
providers.note: Asked for a card.

providers.name: Aion Labs
providers.free: Permanent free tier, no credit card required. 15 RPM, 20K tokens/day. Specialized for roleplay and storytelling. (no card required)
providers.note: Roleplay-only models.

providers.name: BazaarLink
providers.free: 10 requests per minute, 50 requests per day; accounts without credit get ×1 of the daily quota; accounts with credit get ×2. Free tier rules → https://bazaarlink.ai/en/docs#free-models (no card required)
providers.note: Tiny quotas or one-off credit.

providers.name: SkillBoss
providers.free: $2 free credits for OpenAI-compatible endpoints without requiring a credit card (no card required)
providers.note: Tiny quotas or one-off credit.

providers.name: Plugsky
providers.free: 100,000 tokens per day, 10 requests per minute, 30+ models, no credit card required, no expiry, OpenAI-compatible format, data not used for training. (no card required)
providers.note: Tiny quotas or one-off credit.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.note: Retired on 30 July 2026 (docs.github.com/en/rest/models): its inference API, catalog and playground are gone; Copilot itself issues no API key.
